ja: －－－　「ＲＧ 1/144 Hi-νガンダム」（別売り　2021年9月店頭販売商品）連動アイテムが登場！　－－－
※この商品にＭＳ本体は含まれません。
戦 場 を 穿 つ 一 撃 ―
コミック『機動戦士ガンダム逆襲のシャア ベルトーチカ・チルドレン』より、
Hi-νガンダムの専用武装“ハイパー・メガ・バズーカ・ランチャー”をＲＧシリーズで初立体化。
●　完全新規設計による洗練された造形
メカニカルデザイナー柳瀬敬之氏による設定画稿を基に、ハイパー・メガ・バズーカ・ランチャーの特徴的な形状を細部にわたり徹底再現。
ＲＧシリーズならではの精密かつシャープな造形で補完。
●　全長約３００ｍｍを超す長砲身を1/144スケールで体感
肩部ドッキングアームや冷却用ボンベなど細部にわたり徹底再現。
●　劇中を再現するオプションパーツが付属
母艦ラー・カイラムから射出されるエネルギー・チューブと射出ユニットを再現。射出ユニットは付属のアクションベースへの接続が可能。
エネルギー・チューブに取り付けられたビーコンを、ランチャーへ接続可能。
●　クリアブラックカラーのアクションベースが２個付属
臨場感のあるディスプレイを可能。
●　新規デザインリアリスティックデカールが付属！

en: --- "RG 1/144 Hi-νGundam" (sold separately 20219 in-store sales product) linked items are now available! ---
*This product does not include the MS body.
A blow that pierces the battlefield.
From the comic ``Mobile Suit Gundam: Char's Counterattack Bertochika Children''
Hi-νGundam's exclusive weapon "Hyper Mega Bazooka Launcher" is made into a three-dimensional model for the first time in the RG series.
● Sophisticated shape with completely new design
Based on the setting drawings by mechanical designer Noriyuki Yanase, the characteristic shape of the Hyper Mega Bazooka Launcher is thoroughly reproduced in every detail.
Supplemented with precision and sharp modeling unique to the RG series.
● Experience the long gun barrel with a total length of over 300mm with 1/144 Scale
Thorough reproduction of details such as the shoulder docking arm and cooling cylinder.
● Comes with optional parts to recreate the scene in the play.
Reproduces the energy tube and injection unit ejected from the mothership Ra Kailum. The injection unit can be connected to the included action base.
The beacon attached to the energy tube can be connected to the launcher.
● Two clear black action bases are included.
Enables a realistic display.
● Newly designed realistic decal included!
Set contents: Hyper Mega Bazooka Launcher set / Action Base 4 (black clear color) / Action Base 5 (black clear color) / Realistic decal
This product is combined with "RG 1/144 Hi-νGundam" (sold separately 20219 in-store sales product),
A product to reproduce the equipped state of "Hyper Mega Bazooka Launcher".
*The MS body is not included with this product.
* To reproduce the published photo, this product and "RG 1/144 Hi-νGundam" (sold separately, 20219 over-the-counter product) are required.
* Due to the weight of this product, please display it in a stable location, referring to the poses in the photo.
*Depending on sales conditions, the quantity that can be purchased may change in the future.
1/144 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 15 years old or older
Main product material: PS/PVC
・No adhesive is used for assembly
*The finished product in the photo has been partially painted. Also, a prototype that is still under development. There may be slight differences from the actual product.
*Please note that some of the clear parts may contain air bubbles due to the manufacturing process.
*Product materials may change depending on the production period of the sold product. Thank you for your understanding.
